name: china-inspection-saas
description: Enterprise Inspection & Loading Management SaaS Platform

scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix server install
scripts.build:copy: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.cpSync('client/dist', 'dist', {recursive: true}); if(fs.existsSync('uploads')) fs.cpSync('uploads', 'dist/uploads', {recursive: true});"
scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:server && npm run build:copy
scripts.dev: cd client && npm run build && cd ../server && npx tsx src/index.ts
